parameters.name: extraConditions
maxResults
parameters.description: Maximum number of results returned per page, ranging from 0 to 200. Default value is 20.

parameters.name: nextToken
parameters.description: Leave this field empty for the first page. For subsequent pages, use the value of this field from the previous response to retrieve the next set of paginated data.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: Organization identity, also known as organization ID, in string format. It can be obtained from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access link, for example: https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Visibility Type, with values "all" or "collect", representing all projects or my collected projects, respectively.
